newsitem.title: UK: British murderer West to spend whole life in jail.
newsitem.headline: British murderer West to spend whole life in jail.

text.p: A British woman jailed for killing 10 young women and girls in what was dubbed the "House of Horrors" case has been told she will never be freed, officials said on Tuesday.
British Home Secretary (Interior Minister) Jack Straw decided that Rosemary West should serve a whole life tariff, in line with the recommendation of the judge at her trial.
"She was informed of this decision last week," a ministry spokesman said.
West, whose husband Fred was found hanged in his prison cell while awaiting trial, was given 10 life sentences in November 1995 after a trial that shocked Britain.
Among those she was convicted of murdering were her own daughter Heather and stepdaughter Charmaine.
Lawyers vowed to appeal against the ruling, but West's son Stephen said he welcomed Straw's decision, as his mother had never shown any signs of remorse.
"She should just accept her punishment," he told the Daily Mail newspaper.
